# QR Code generator

The C version of Project Nayuki's QR Code generator library, MIT licensed
(see `LICENSE`).

Upstream: https://github.com/nayuki/QR-Code-generator, release v1.8.0
(`c/qrcodegen.c`, SHA-256
300eff07ee25baaa7578f20284411638154716379437391e7e689c0e6ce81403;
`c/qrcodegen.h`, SHA-256
e82df4bff37d18b5863b9e7486fe6bda1b6cda8c3b9ecebfec473907265cb589), copied
unchanged.

The Steam Workshop screen's sign-in shows its QR code, made with it, for
the Steam app to scan (port/android/host/steam_downloads.c, in the Android
app's host).
